naslov: Man arrested on stalking charges at LeBron James' home in Los Angeles
tekst:
A man was arrested Friday night at LeBron James' Brentwood, California, home, a Los Angeles Police Department spokesperson confirmed to ESPN on Saturday.
LAPD officers responded to a call at 9:39 p.m. Friday to investigate a possible burglary on James' property, the spokesperson said.
A suspect was apprehended at the residence, taken into custody and booked for stalking, the spokesperson said.
James was in Cleveland on Friday night for his Philadelphia 76ers' game against the Cavaliers. The Sixers lost 119-95 to his former team.
On Sunday, when asked about the man who was arrested for stalking his home, James said, "My family is safe and that's the most important. We're still looking into everything."
ESPN's Kris Rhim contributed to this report.
